subject: Reasoning
description: Light arrangement / ranking puzzles suited for Bank/SSC

questions.stem: Five boys — A, B, C, D, E — sit in a row. C sits immediately right of A. D is to the immediate left of A. E is at one end. Which boy is in the middle?
questions.explanation: Order with D-A-C fixed (3 consecutive). E at one end. B occupies remaining position. Possible lineups: E-D-A-C-B or B-D-A-C-E. In both, A is in the middle (3rd of 5).
questions.subject: Reasoning

questions.stem: A is taller than B. B is shorter than C. D is taller than A. Who is the SHORTEST?
questions.explanation: A > B, C > B, D > A. So A, C, D are all taller than B. B is the shortest. Ordering A vs C cannot be fixed, but B at bottom is certain.
questions.subject: Reasoning

questions.stem: Six friends are sitting in a row. P is at the extreme right. Q is between P and R. S is to the immediate left of R. T is between S and U. Who is at the extreme LEFT?
questions.explanation: P is at extreme right. Q between P & R → order ... R, Q, P. S immediate left of R → ... S, R, Q, P. T between S and U → ... U, T, S, R, Q, P. 6 names all placed. Extreme left = U.
questions.subject: Reasoning

questions.stem: In a line, Sachin is 10th from the left and Virat is 15th from the right. They exchange positions — now Sachin becomes 18th from the left. Total number of people is:
questions.explanation: After swap, Sachin takes Virat's old position. If Sachin is 18th from left, he is also at Virat's old spot (15th from right). Total = 18 + 15 − 1 = 32.
questions.subject: Reasoning

questions.stem: In a row of girls facing NORTH: Priya is 7th from the left, Neha is 11th from the right. If they interchange, Priya becomes 16th from the left. Total girls in the row is:
questions.explanation: After exchange, Priya = Neha's old position = 11th from right and 16th from left. Total = 16 + 11 − 1 = 26.
questions.subject: Reasoning

questions.stem: In a class of 40 students, Meena is 12th from the top. Shyam is 19 places BELOW Meena. What is Shyam's rank from the bottom?
questions.explanation: Meena's rank from top = 12. Shyam = 12 + 19 = 31st from top. Rank from bottom = 40 − 31 + 1 = 10.
questions.subject: Reasoning

questions.stem: Five boxes — P, Q, R, S, T — are stacked vertically. T is at the top. S is immediately above P. R is somewhere between T and S. Q is at the bottom. What is the order from TOP to BOTTOM?
questions.explanation: T top, Q bottom. Remaining R, S, P in positions 2, 3, 4. 'S immediately above P' → adjacent pair S-P (top-to-bottom). R between T and S → R at position 2, S at 3, P at 4. Order: T-R-S-P-Q.
